baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 is the Qur'an noun from ق ر ء, and word 2 qualifies it through ح ك م.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first term presents reading or recitation as an enacted discourse, while the adjective supplies knowledge that reaches a right judgment.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation make the noun an enacted discourse and supply the model's voiced medium.
Wisdom and right-hitting knowledge give that recitation its epistemic calibration.

changed_reading.before: An oath by a scripture described as wise.
changed_reading.after: An oath by a recited discourse whose knowing is accurate enough to orient judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ق ر ء noun at word 1 is directly joined to the ح ك م qualifier at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gathering supplies the compositional action and exact construction supplies the rule that holds the gathered parts together.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining make the Qur'an a collected whole rather than an undifferentiated object.
Tight construction and reliability make exact ordering the principle of the collection.

changed_reading.after: A composition that gathers dispersed units into a securely ordered whole is invoked.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The recitational branch of ق ر ء at word 1 is qualified by the corrective and judicial branches of ح ك م at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: Voiced discourse restrains disorder by returning a disputed or wayward case to a governing decision.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the audible medium through which correction can operate.
Preventing and turning back for reform make the qualifier actively corrective.
Judgment between parties gives corrective restraint an adjudicative form.

changed_reading.after: The recitation exercises corrective jurisdiction by restraining disorder and deciding between courses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 permits the path, model, and intended-course branch of ق ر ء; word 2 supplies exactness through ح ك م.
baseline_models.mechanism: The named discourse can be approached as a reproducible course whose pattern is secured rather than merely as information.

activation_trace.role: A path, model, or intended course turns the Qur'an noun into a followable pattern.
Exact construction keeps the proposed course coherent and dependable.

changed_reading.before: The focus names a wise text.
changed_reading.after: The focus invokes a deliberately patterned way whose form can be followed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The time-arriving or time-delayed branch of ق ر ء at word 1 is immediately governed by exact ح ك م at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: A recital can carry an occasion or delay, while exact governance fixes its fitting moment.

activation_trace.role: A time that comes near or is delayed supplies the recital with temporal charge.
Exactness turns loose temporal charge into a precisely governed occasion.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an is wise without an explicit temporal mechanism.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is a time-bearing proclamation whose occasion is exactly set.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's patterned-way possibility becomes a directed transmission: it is dispatched, laid along a straight course, and delivered from a source.

activation_trace.role: A path or model supplies the focus noun with a traversable pattern.
Exact construction makes that traversable pattern stable rather than improvised.
Dispatch and being sent mobilize the pattern toward recipients.
A straight road supplies the concrete geometry of the focus's patterned course.
Uprightness and balance make the road's straightness a maintained condition.
Bringing something down and delivering it supplies the route with a source-to-recipient vector.

structural_cues: The oath is followed immediately by sentness, a straight path, and descent.
The sequence moves from discourse to carrier to route to delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, straightness, and delivery; I infer that they describe how the focus noun's wise pattern operates, while the live alternative is that they certify only the messenger.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an is a securely patterned text.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is a delivered route-pattern that carries wise ordering from its source into human movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering becomes an accounting operation: acts and traces are joined, exhaustively enumerated, and finally brought together into inspectable presence.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed material makes collection the focus noun's operative image.
Judgment gives the gathered material a destination as an adjudicable record.
Joining one item to another supplies the mechanics of constructing the record.
Counting by exhaustive survey prevents any gathered trace from dropping out.
Drawing the dispersed into one collected state externalizes the focus's gathering branch.
Near, witnessed presence makes the collected whole available for judgment.
The repeated gathering image confirms that collection is a surah-scale operation.
Repeated presentation converts gathering from storage into accountable appearance.

structural_cues: Writing deeds and traces is paired with exhaustive enumeration in 36:12.
The all-gathered and all-presented sequence recurs at 36:32 and 36:53.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, exhaustive count, gathering, and presentation; I infer that these sharpen the focus noun into an ordering instrument, while the alternative is that they remain only events narrated inside it.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an gathers its own verbal parts into an exact composition.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an models a wise register that gathers acts, traces, and persons into an exhaustive, adjudicable presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's time-bearing branch is expanded into measured recurrence: assigned limits, return through stations, circular courses, temporary extension, and an appointed promise.

activation_trace.role: A time that approaches or is delayed makes the focus noun capable of carrying occasion.
Exact construction turns occasion into calibrated sequence.
Measured governance supplies the directing intelligence behind recurring motion.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit segments recurrence into determinate stages.
Return after departure supplies the repeating motion within the measured stages.
A celestial course gives recurrent timing a stable track.
A thing's proper time sets a boundary on temporary extension.
An appointment fixed by time or place converts expectation into a scheduled horizon.

structural_cues: The sun, moon, night, and day are presented as non-colliding ordered sequences.
Temporary extension until a time is followed by the question of when the promise arrives and then by sudden fulfillment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measures, returns, courses, a bounded time, and an appointment; I infer that these activate the focus's temporal ق ر ء branch, while its lexical distance from the Qur'an noun remains a live alternative against the model.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an bears an exactly chosen occasion in an abstract sense.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is a calibrated recital that coordinates recurrence, delay, and sudden fulfillment within wise timing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The corrective arbiter becomes executable speech: a word acquires necessity, recompense matches action, witnesses disclose knowledge, and command passes into occurrence.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the speech event whose effects are being tested.
Judgment between people makes the qualifier juridical rather than merely sapiential.
Necessary obligation makes the announced word binding rather than optional.
Speech as a thing's boundary makes utterance define the case it addresses.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the judgment's exact execution.
Disclosure grounded in knowledge turns embodied evidence into judicial testimony.
Command and obligation supply an authoritative speech-act structure.
Spoken utterance links command to the event that follows it.

structural_cues: The word becomes due near both the opening and the later self-description of the Qur'an.
Judgment is rendered without mismatch, and bodily testimony replaces ordinary verbal defense.
The surah closes its causal argument with command followed by occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding speech, matched recompense, testimony, and effective command; I infer a shared performative logic for the focus recitation, while God's creative command remains distinguishable from Qur'anic recitation.

changed_reading.before: The recitation wisely comments on judgment.
changed_reading.after: The recitation is adjudicating speech whose wise distinctions become binding, witnessed, and executable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening oath term returns near the end as clear recitation, paired with reminder and directed warning; wisdom now appears as the capacity to reactivate memory and address responsive life.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation establish the focus as an event of address.
Corrective restraint gives the address a reforming purpose.
Tracing step after step makes reception a continued following rather than a single hearing.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the address with memory-reactivating force.
The repeated Qur'an noun re-performs the opening recitational branch inside the surah.
Warning that awakens caution specifies the recitation's corrective action.
Living spirit marks the kind of recipient in whom warning can become response.

structural_cues: The same Qur'an noun frames the surah at 36:2 and 36:69.
The later recurrence is explicitly separated from poetry, paired with reminder, and followed by its warning purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, reminder, repeated recitation, warning, and living reception; I infer that wise recitation diagnoses and activates responsiveness, while the alternative is that life names only a prior audience condition.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an is a truth-hitting recitation.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is a clarifying, memory-reactivating address whose wise correction meets and tests living responsiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The return branch of the focus adjective becomes directional: the recitation calls for reorientation, contrasts blocked worldly return with final universal return, and thereby turns wisdom into a force of redirection.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the medium through which redirection can be heard.
Turning back or causing return makes the adjective dynamically reorienting.
Return to a prior source supplies the recitation's ultimate direction.
Inability to return exposes the failure of voluntary reorientation.
Universal return closes the directional arc as an unavoidable destination.

structural_cues: Return appears as destination, denied recovery, failed motion, and the surah's final movement.
The last clause turns the entire intervening discourse toward a single endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated return and non-return; I infer that the rare return branch of ح ك م describes the recitation's reorienting work, while the ordinary wisdom sense remains the stronger lexical alternative.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an offers static wise guidance.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is a returning discourse that redirects hearers toward the source to which all are finally returned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The greeting branch of ق ر ء is activated by a salutation explicitly presented as speech from a merciful Lord, allowing the wise recitation to function as conveyance as well as judgment.

activation_trace.role: Reading or conveying a greeting makes salutation a latent speech-act of the focus noun.
Judicial authority makes the conveyed salutation a sovereign outcome rather than casual courtesy.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the greeting's conferred condition.
Spoken utterance makes peace an explicitly delivered word.
Mercy and tenderness identify the relation from which the authoritative greeting comes.

structural_cues: The salutation is grammatically identified as speech and sourced from the merciful Lord.
It occurs after adjudicative separation, so peace appears as one outcome of wise rule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies peace as merciful sovereign speech; I infer that the focus's greeting branch makes the Qur'an its conveyance, while the live alternative is that 36:58 remains a quoted future utterance without redefining the opening noun.

changed_reading.before: The wise Qur'an conveys instruction and judgment.
changed_reading.after: The wise Qur'an can also be heard as the authorized conveyance of peace that its judgment makes possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the literal bridle branch of ح ك م to discourse. It remains anchored by that focus branch and by the packet's neck, collar, chin, tethering reason, taming, and riding sequence. Render it only as a material analogy for governed motion, not as a lexical replacement for 'wise.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2's ح ك م inventory includes a bridle that surrounds the jaws and prevents uncontrolled running; word 1 can simultaneously supply a patterned course.

activation_trace.role: A bridle around the jaws supplies the material control interface for the outlier.
A path or intended course gives bridle-like control a direction rather than mere stoppage.
The physical neck localizes the control image in the same bodily zone as a bridle.
A collar binding a limb supplies coercive restraint as the failed counterpart to wise guidance.
The joining point of the jaws makes the bridle branch anatomically concrete.
Tethering a camel supplies restraint as a model for reasoned self-governance.
Taming and easing after difficulty supply controlled usability rather than immobilization.
Riding supplies the purposeful movement made possible by successful control.

changed_reading.before: The wise Qur'an verbally indicates a path.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Qur'an is a bridle-like governing interface that regulates whether movement on the path becomes directed, blocked, or usable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers reproductive containment to discourse. It remains anchored by the focus's womb-gathering branch and by the packet's carrying, fullness, germinal drop, origination, and renewed life. Render it only as an exploratory material analogy for how signs are borne toward re-creation, never as a lexical gloss of Qur'an.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1's ق ر ء inventory includes a womb gathering a load, while word 2's ح ك م inventory can secure what is formed within that containment.

activation_trace.role: A womb gathering blood or a fetus supplies the outlier's generative container.
Tight formation and reliability make containment a governed development rather than an amorphous heap.
An inward load or fruit activates bearing as a hidden generative process.
Filling a carrier supplies the material capacity to bear a gathered plurality.
A germinal drop supplies a minimal origin from which a developed addressee emerges.
Originating and bringing into being supply the transition from contained potential to formed life.
Living spirit supplies the developed outcome toward which the carrier analogy points.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an gathers verbal material into an exact whole.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Qur'an is a tightly governed carrier that gathers germinal signs and bears them toward renewed life.

strongest_changes: The opening object became a delivered route-pattern through the immediate sentness, straight-path, and descent sequence.
Its gathering branch became an exhaustive accounting mechanism through writing, enumeration, repeated gathering, and presentation.
The ح ك م qualifier became executable adjudication through binding speech, matched recompense, testimony, and effective command.
The late recurrence of the Qur'an noun made the opening oath a living, memory-reactivating address rather than a static title.
A compact but well-anchored branch activation heard the recitation as authorized conveyance of sovereign peace.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence changed the two-word oath from a static description into several operating mechanisms: route, register, clock, court, summons, return, and salutation. The material bridle and gestational readings remained live only with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The return and bridle branches of ح ك م are visibly activated but remain more form-distant than wisdom, judgment, and exactness.
The time, greeting, and womb branches of ق ر ء may function as productive analogies without determining the ordinary sense of the Qur'an noun.
The surah's creative command sharpens the performative-speech model, but it should not be collapsed into the distinct act of Qur'anic recitation.
